Bringing relatives
I don’t really want to read how easy was for you to bring your family here without asking permission, it’s already very frustrating that it’s not being easy for me. 

I want to bring my 76yo grandma to Israel. She’s from an exempted visa country (Brasil) but due to her age I didn’t wanted to risk that she would just come and then something would happen so we went to Jaffa MH and applied for her to come as tourist. We had to submit her passport, invitation letter, forms, pictures of us together. Today, 15 days later we got an email saying that we need to submit the following documents: 

My grandma birth certificate 

My great grandmother birth certificate  

+ documents proving where she lives etc. 

Makes no sense to me that they request my more than 30y dead great grandmother, anyway we submitted the documents in Portuguese, I’m wondering if they will be worse and ask them translated? 

It’s very tiring that everything is over complicated, also I’m afraid that they will ask a bail + send my grandma to get a physical visa in the embassy that’s +6h trip. If they do that, there’s anyway we can appeal? At least for the physical visa, I’m sure they can do something in the system but ofc they prefer to be a pain in the sss. 

Thanks
